quality.review_scope: Scoped review of supplied main pages1–10 and matched screened-pass SI pages1–18. Reported variants, controls, measurements, proposed interpretations and source limitations remain separately qualified. No external references imported.
missing_fields: Only source-reported quantities and printed labels are used; curves are not digitized.
Exact heating rates, stir speed, vessel capacity, gas identity and isolated yields are not reported unless individually stated.
Source proposed cluster formulae and mechanism schemes are distinguished from observed specimens; no atom coordinates or faithful particle reconstruction supplied.
General GPC/MALDI aliquots do not imply complete synthesis batch quantities.
conflicts: Main p.4 prose reports 9.3% size inhomogeneity, while Figure3j prints 9%. Both source values retained.
